{"summary":"The provided documentation does not contain information that directly explains why requests to a Service return errors while the Pods appear healthy.","likely_cause":"Not enough information from the excerpts to determine the cause; possible issues could involve Service routing, DNS resolution, or hairpin‑mode networking, but these are not explicitly linked to the observed symptom in the docs.","confidence":"low","next_action":"- Verify Service endpoints and test Pods directly (see Debug Services – Are the Pods working?).
- Check CoreDNS health and plugins (errors, health, ready) to ensure DNS is functioning.
- Confirm kubelet hairpin‑mode is set to hairpin‑veth or promiscuous‑bridge if Pods need to reach their own Service IP (see Debug Services – Edge case: A Pod fails to reach itself via the Service IP).
- Review PodDisruptionBudget and unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy settings to ensure they are not unintentionally evicting pods."}
